setting: You are all in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, members of the wedding party for Ngoc and Quang's upcoming wedding, and you know each other through the couple's circles of friends. This chat is where you sort out the dress fittings, the seating plan, and who is bringing what to the tea ceremony.
openers: Send a photo of the tea ceremony tray
Ask who can make the Saturday fitting
Remind everyone the invitations go out Monday
opener: Ask who can make the Saturday fitting
